remarks: Eastside Commons Finest...Top Floor...Top Drawer. This 2 Bedroom, 2 full bathroom + loft, with extra bonus room features a desirable courtyard view. This exceptional recently updated unit boasts impressive 9-foot + ceilings and an array of desirable features. Upon entering, you'll be greeted by a spacious layout with new luxury vinyl floors and abundant windows. The eat in kitchen with center island includes brand new LG gas appliances, ample cabinetry and stone countertops. The primary bedroom which features an en suite bathroom and a generous walk-in closet, also has slider access to the balcony overlooking the greenbelt. The loft with a bonus storage room overlooks the large living room and balcony, creating an open and airy ambiance throughout. Residents enjoy access to a range of outstanding amenities within the building, including a fitness center, a spacious courtyard complete with gas grills and comfortable outdoor seating, and garage parking with two elevator access points for added convenience. Within a short walk to a variety of restaurants and shopping. Conveniently located just a short distance from I-95, downtown Stamford, and the Stamford Metro North / Amtrak train station, this property offers exceptional accessibility to transportation and urban life.
